mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a separate contractor for countertop installation if I'm already renovating my kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically do not need to hire a separate contractor if your renovation company, like Frasheski Construction, offers full-service project management, including countertop installation. Consolidating the work with one contractor simplifies communication, streamlines scheduling, and ensures better coordination with other renovation tasks such as cabinetry or plumbing. This integrated approach can prevent delays and inconsistencies that might arise when managing multiple independent trades.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, if your renovation company offers full-service project management, they will coordinate countertop installation as part of the overall project, streamlining the process.
